name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: Ebola passes 10,350 cases in DR Congo with imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria
state: Official figures reported on 1 Nov put the DR Congo outbreak at 10,351 cases and 5,026 deaths (Morning Star). WHO's 23 Oct update counted nine confirmed cases in Kenya and one imported case in Nigeria, announced on 20 Oct, and rates the risk very high in DR Congo, high for neighbours and low globally.
for_you: Risk in the UK is very low. Travellers to affected areas should follow FCDO, NaTHNaC and UKHSA guidance.
rubric_hit: Spread to new countries within 30 days (Nigeria, 20 Oct) = Alert

sources.title: Morning Star — World in brief, 1 November 2026

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
